description: La Sarthe à vélo (segment) is a dataset listed in data.sarthe.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de la Sarthe. La Sarthe à vélo sous forme de segments de la BdTopo des routes, caractérisés par le type de revêtement et le type d'utilisation. Coverage: Sarthe. The portal files it under Territoires. Its keywords are Vélo, nature, Territoires, activité physique. The portal shows 2,682 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-sarthe-fr-portal.
